services.name: Sunset sail - Philadelphia Waterfront
services.desc: Enjoy a beautiful sunset on the water Duration 1.5 Hours About Golden hour sun glistening off glass skyscrapers and rippling waters... The views of Philadelphia from the Delaware river at sunset are breathtaking. Our captain will take you on a leisurely cruise North past the Ben Franklin Bridge to take a look at Cherry Street and Race Street piers from the water. We'll continue toward Graffiti Pier and a view of the ever evolving public art. Depending on the winds and tides our captain will deploy the sails and head back South past Petty Island where you can observe wildlife and natural vegetation on this storied island in the middle of the Delaware river. services.name: Chef's Table
services.desc: A Philadelphia chef, six seats, and a table where no one has sat before About Chef’s Table is pulled straight from the city’s food scene and served in a setting most people haven’t imagined. One chef, six guests, a sailboat, and a menu created for that date only. The captain handles the ride. The chef handles the food. You get an experience that exists once and never repeats. There’s no script, no preset story. Just a chef cooking their way through a meal while the skyline shifts in the background. services.name: Sailing tour - Historic Philadelphia Waterfront
services.desc: Enjoy historic stories while on the water Duration 3 Hours About Sail down the Delaware river during this unique history tour! Our guide, Calico Jack, will share a history of Philadelphia and the Delaware waterfront. We'll sail on the Western bank of the Delaware river as far south as historic Fort Mifflin... detailing the history and stories of iconic waterfront locations and features like the Cruiser Olympia, the Philadelphia Coast Guard station, the Philadelphia Navy Yard, and more. We'll return up the river on the opposite bank taking a look at Red Bank battlefield, the Walt Whitman bridge, the Battleship New Jersey, and we'll sprinkle in the histories of locals and natives throughout.
